value.summary: Added leveled logging to lib/logger.mjs with levels debug/info/warn/error (default info), setLevel/getLevel for control, and kept log() as an info-level alias for backward compatibility. Added test/logger.test.mjs covering filtering at the default level, suppression of below-level messages, setLevel behavior, invalid-level rejection, and legacy log() output. Ran the test suite; all tests pass. Satisfied: leveled logging introduced, existing log() behavior preserved at default settings, tests written and passing.
